lia: FYI: on-call saw venice13b-int4 canary blow up with OOMs on long responses (~400+ generated tokens). Happened after we enabled the new fused-attn + int4 quant rollout. stack excerpt below: 

```
CUDA error: out of memory when allocating 1.3 GiB (device 0, total 32 GiB, 30.9 GiB used, 256 MiB free)
  at runtime/infer.cc:211
```

lia: Quick repro locally: `MODEL=venice13b-int4 ./tools/repro --prompt sample_long.json --max_new_tokens 512 --batch 3` -> OOM ~90% of runs. With `--max_new_tokens 200` it completes.

omar: interesting. fused-attn path allocates a separate workspace buffer that scales with seq_len and alignment for int4. it can be a few hundred MB extra. did you capture peak alloc map?

lia: grabbed a simple peak dump:
```
peak_alloc: 30.9 GiB
fused_workspace: 1.1 GiB
kv_prefetch_buffer: 320 MiB
fragmentation_gaps: ~480 MiB
```

harper: that matches a hypothesis we've seen: quantized kernels + our 256B alignment padding push the allocator past the compaction threshold, leaving unusable holes. longer gens + prefetching kicks it over.

ryan: short term mitigations we can roll: 1) reduce venice13b default max_new_tokens to 200, 2) disable kv_prefetch for that model id, 3) soft-limit batch_size to 2 for canary. any objections?

lia: none. i'll open a small canary change for model config.

omar: also try forcing `kernel_choice=legacy` in runtime for sequences > 350 to see if fused path is the main culprit. if legacy passes and fused fails, that's a smoking gun.

lia: ran that experiment: `--max_new_tokens 512 --batch 3 --kernel_choice=legacy` -> no OOMs in 30 runs. with fused it OOMs within 5 runs.

harper: good signal. we should instrument fused workspace per-request in telemetry so we don't rely on manual dumps. i'll file a quick infra ticket.

lia: PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/patches/3498. changes: default max_new_tokens=200, kv_prefetch=false, batch_soft_limit=2 for venice13b-int4. includes reproducer and CI smoke.

ops-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: venice13b-int4 config patch -> 5% traffic now, ramp to 25% in 30m if no errors. CI: green.

ryan: additionally i'll add a runtime policy that prefers legacy_attn for any request where requested_new_tokens > 350. canary to 10% traffic. keeps fused in place for short responses.

harper: future work: (A) reduce int4 alignment padding or use smaller slab granularity, (B) adjust allocator.compact_threshold to trigger earlier, (C) add per-kernel workspace accounting in metrics. estimate 2-sprint combined effort.

qa-bot: smoke tests: 50 long-run iterations on canary after config change -> 0 OOMs (previously 17/50 failures). baseline latency regressed +3% for legacy kernel on long gens, but within SLO.

lia: canary has been stable for 4 hours at 10% traffic with synthetic load matching failure shape. leaving monitoring window open 24h.

ryan: created follow-up cards: INF-2104 (allocator compaction), INF-2105 (kernel workspace telemetry), INF-2106 (quant padding audit). assigning to harper & omar.

lia: TL;DR for ops notes: temporary defaults changed for venice13b-int4: max_new_tokens=200, kv_prefetch=false, soft_batch_limit=2; runtime policy to fallback to legacy_attn when requested_new_tokens>350; PR #3498 applied to canary. will escalate if alerts fire.

ops-bot: Alert rule added: `model.venice13b_int4.oom_rate` -> notify eng-ml if >0.5/hour.

omar: nice troubleshooting. once INF-2105 lands we can measure true fused workspace and maybe enable fused for long gens again after allocator fixes.

lia: thanks everyone. closing thread after 24h unless new issues arise.
